_guide._comment: 求职版网站的内容配置文件。JSON 不支持真正的注释，所以说明写在 _comment / _help 字段里，网页会自动忽略这些说明。
_guide.editing: 修改文字时只改双引号里的内容。修改图片时先把图片放到 assets 文件夹，再把 path 改成 assets/文件名。
_guide.cv: 把英文 CV PDF 放到 assets 文件夹后，将 links.cv.href 改成真实文件路径，例如 assets/Pan-Hu-CV.pdf。
_guide.externalLinks: Ertha Home、Instagram、LinkedIn 都使用真实外链。发布前请手动点击测试。

image.alt: Ertha Home SEO and GEO workflow covering technical audit, keyword research, on-page optimisation and search monitoring
image.caption: SEO / GEO & Content

content.overview: Led technical and on-page SEO for Ertha Home, using AI-assisted research and Google Search Console to prioritise fixes, improve visibility and guide ongoing optimisation.

contributions.title: 01 — Technical SEO
contributions.body: Used **AI-assisted research** and **Google Search Console** to prioritise technical and on-page SEO fixes, increasing search impressions by **133.4%**, organic clicks by **41.5%**, and improving average position from **14.18 to 8.66** in **28 days**.

contributions.title: 02 — Homepage & Product Visibility
contributions.body: Optimised homepage and product visibility through metadata, content, **Product Schema** and **Breadcrumb Schema**, generating **482 homepage impressions**, an **8.3% CTR**, and **283 product rich-result impressions** in **28 days**.

contributions.title: 03 — On-page SEO
contributions.body: Built and managed **174 SEO landing pages** across product, collection and content pages, aligning pages with search intent and reducing keyword cannibalisation.

contributions.title: 04 — Monitoring & Iteration
contributions.body: Monitored performance through **Google Search Console** and used search data to guide ongoing optimisation and content decisions.

image.alt: Instagram content overview and performance analytics for Ertha Home
image.caption: Social Media & Content

content.overview: Built Ertha Home’s Instagram presence from the ground up, using an organic content strategy to grow the audience, improve product discovery and support e-commerce performance.

contributions.title: 01 — Content Strategy
contributions.body: Developed an organic content strategy around visual storytelling, product discovery and audience growth, using performance insights to refine content formats and topics.

contributions.title: 02 — Organic Audience Growth
contributions.body: Grew the account to **10K+ total followers**, adding **6.6K followers** and generating **784K+ views in one month** through organic content.

contributions.title: 03 — E-commerce Impact
contributions.body: The organic social strategy supported a **400% increase in orders** and a **102% increase in conversion rate**.

contributions.title: 04 — Performance-led Optimisation
contributions.body: Used audience and content-performance insights to guide ongoing optimisation of topics, formats and product storytelling.

image.alt: Ertha Home Shopify storefront shown across laptop, tablet and mobile devices

content.overview: Built and managed Ertha Home’s Shopify store, using AI workflows to optimise and maintain SEO landing pages across product, collection and content pages.

contributions.title: 01 — Shopify Store Build
contributions.body: Built and managed Ertha Home’s **Shopify store**, using **AI workflows** to support ongoing optimisation and maintenance.

contributions.title: 02 — SEO Landing Pages
contributions.body: Optimised and maintained **174 SEO landing pages** across product, collection and content pages.

contributions.title: 03 — Search-intent Alignment
contributions.body: Aligned landing pages with search intent to strengthen organic visibility across product, collection and content journeys.

contributions.title: 04 — Keyword Cannibalisation Reduction
contributions.body: Maintained page structure and content coverage to reduce keyword cannibalisation across the site.

image.alt: MEI PI QI circular bayberry brand logo centred on a white background
MEI PI QI consumer insights, competitor landscape and brand direction research summary

content.overview: Conducted consumer and competitor research to understand category perceptions, identify market opportunities, and define the strategic direction for the rebrand.

contributions.title: 01 — Consumer & Keyword Research
contributions.body: Used **Python** to analyse **572 consumer reviews**, identifying customer preferences and informing the rebranding direction.

contributions.title: 02 — Competitor Benchmarking
contributions.body: Benchmarked competitors to identify customer preferences and opportunities for differentiation in positioning, visual identity and digital presence.

contributions.title: 03 — Brand Positioning
contributions.body: Refined Gen Z targeting and brand positioning using consumer and competitor insights, with a projected **35% improvement in targeting effectiveness**.

image.alt: MEI PI QI brand identity, IP character development and packaging strategy

content.overview: Led the visual and packaging direction for the rebrand, translating brand positioning into clear creative decisions for younger consumers and different usage scenarios.

contributions.title: 01 — Brand Identity Direction
contributions.body: Defined the brand’s **core visual direction and identity principles**, establishing how the brand should look and feel across packaging, content, and offline touchpoints.

contributions.title: 02 — IP Concept & Art Direction
contributions.body: Defined the **IP concept and creative direction**, combining traditional Chinese opera-inspired elements with bayberry cues to shape a distinctive character for Gen Z audiences.

contributions.title: 03 — Packaging Design
contributions.body: Defined a **scenario-based packaging strategy** for outdoor, gifting, and office/study use, selecting formats and materials based on different consumer needs.

image.alt: MEI PI QI pop-up experience, IP merchandise and online-to-offline engagement campaign

content.overview: Developed a pop-up activation strategy to bring the rebranded identity into physical experiences and strengthen engagement with younger consumers.

contributions.title: 01 — Pop-up Experience
contributions.body: Designed pop-up events and digital marketing campaigns to drive engagement, with a projected **15–20% improvement in conversion rates**.

contributions.title: 02 — IP Merchandise
contributions.body: Designed merchandise concepts to extend the rebranded identity beyond beverages and into lifestyle touchpoints.

contributions.title: 03 — Online-to-Offline Engagement
contributions.body: Designed an online-to-offline engagement model using QR codes, points-based rewards, check-ins and social sharing.
